Good Morning Rakshith

Your check-out inspection has been completed, and your deposit refund has been processed.

However, please note that a deduction of AED 250 has been applied from your deposit for the following:

2 glasses missing: AED 100
2 kitchen utensils damaged: AED 150

The remaining balance of AED 1,250 will be refunded accordingly.

Thank you for your understanding.
